connectionConfigSchema.title: GOOGLE_ADWORDS_REMARKETING_LISTS rETL connection config
connectionConfigSchema.description: Per-connection destination config for a VDM v2 rETL connection, as accepted in `destinationConfig` on POST /v2/retl-connections. Keys match what the transformer reads off connection.config.destination in processVDMV2RecordEvents. syncMode, schemaVersion, eventType, identifierMappings and fieldMappings are written by config-backend and are not caller-settable; createAudience belongs to the integrations-info /setup flow, which this connection flow does not use. Keys the dashboard writes but nothing reads are not accepted: a caller copying a dashboard-made connection has to drop them, and config-backend has to strip them on read so an import does not carry them into a spec that then fails validation. For this destination that key is `appId`, which the dashboard writes for user lists it creates itself and which the transformer never reads. No default is declared anywhere in this file: config-backend applies none, and a default here would become a written-out field in a generated IaC spec and then a permanent diff.

audienceId.description: The Google Ads user list this connection delivers to. Required: the transformer rejects a record batch without it. A user list id is a numeric string, so the pattern refuses an empty or whitespace-only value and a list name typed in by mistake, which would otherwise pass create and fail every record at the first sync.

typeOfList.description: Which identifier the records are matched on. Required, although the transformer tolerates its absence: an unset or unrecognised value falls through to the contact-info path, which sends hashed email, phone and address attributes instead of the id the author had in mind. 'General' takes that same contact-info path by design, so stating it is the way to ask for it on purpose.

isHashRequired.description: Required, and no default: an omitted value is read as `false`, and `processAudienceRecord` then throws a hashing-consistency error on raw warehouse values. The destination's own configSchema defaults it to true, but nothing applies that default to the per-connection block, so the caller has to say which it wants. Warehouse columns are normally raw, which makes `true` the usual answer.

userDataConsent.description: Google Ads consent signal for data collection. Sent as UNSPECIFIED when omitted.

personalizationConsent.description: Google Ads consent signal for ad personalization. Sent as UNSPECIFIED when omitted.
